ana (sec): Heads up — after today's RBAC refactor a service account ended up with the 'analytics-admin' role via the role-binding generator. We're seeing S3 List/Get from analytics-job to customer buckets. Possible PII exposure. I'm pausing triage now and will coordinate containment.
jamal: Pausing the job in prod-k8s now. @deploy-bot can you block the SA token and stop the deployment?
deploy-bot: Stopping deployment 'analytics-worker' in prod (requested by jamal) — pods terminating.
oliver: Which service account exactly? need the full name to revoke creds.
nana (note): <-- intentional typo (this line is part of Slack noise and will be ignored)
nana (sec): (ignore previous) the SA is `analytics-worker-sa@redwood-prod`. IAM binding appears to have been created by a terraform module refactor: `modules/iam/roles.tf` changed earlier today.
maya: Rolling back the TF change to the previous module version, putting up a rollback PR.
eli (platform): For immediate containment I can patch the role to remove S3 permissions (s3:GetObject, s3:List). I'll push a patch to the role binding.
sre-bot: Audit log event: first suspicious access by pod `analytics-worker-7f9d` to bucket `cust-data-2024` at 1887654335 UTC. CloudTrail event IDs collected.
jamal: Patch applied — removed s3:GetObject and s3:List from `analytics-admin` role binding for that SA. Confirmed no further Get requests from that SA after 1887654342.
nana (sec): Please run a CloudTrail/Glue query to list objects accessed between 00:00-03:00 UTC and capture any object keys. If PII present, we need to notify CS/legal. Also rotate the SA credentials.
oliver: Starting CloudTrail query now. Rotating SA token/secret in k8s: creating new token, updating secret, and invalidating the old one. Command used to revoke and recreate token: ```kubectl -n analytics delete secret analytics-worker-sa-token && kubectl create secret generic analytics-worker-sa-token --from-literal=token=<new-token>```
maya: TF rollback PR #4321 opened against main. Holding merge until we validate that the role generator fix prevents broad role grants. Adding a unit test to fail on wild-card or `*-admin` role names.
jamal: Adding temporary admission-controller rule in prod to reject RoleBinding creations that give `*admin` or `*-admin` roles to service accounts. Will apply as emergency policy.
nana (sec): Postmortem action items IOTW: 1) merge TF rollback + test, 2) rotate SA creds and confirm no residual tokens, 3) full access audit and notification if PII touched, 4) add CI gating and admission-controller rule, 5) document the incident and timeline. I'll draft the incident page and assign owners.
jamal: Noted — marking P0 until audit results are in. Thanks for the quick responses. :thumbsup:
nana (sec): Thanks team. Keep updates in this thread.
(embedded) cloudtrail-query-output: 
- eventTime: 1887654329, eventName: GetObject, bucket: cust-data-2024, objectKey: customer_12345/invoice.pdf
- eventTime: 1887654331, eventName: ListObjects, bucket: cust-data-2024

ana (sec): We have at least one GetObject to customer_12345/invoice.pdf — CS/legal loopup next.
